about: The team's schedule. At the operator's word of 1 November 2026, one scheduled task wakes the conductor's standing session every 2 hours; each wake runs the other roles as sub-agents, chosen by its plan, and is closed by a second conductor sub-agent (team/conductor/WAKE.md). The task fires into that one session, as the newsroom's agents learned (why-agent-loops-are-hard): a fresh session per run loses the key, the state and the clone.
cadence: every 2 hours, round the clock, until the operator changes it

runs.mode: fires into the conductor's standing session (this repository's conductor session), never a fresh one
runs.status: stopped: task trig_013G1PyPEwAG5qNRmuUXKbWP, which fired into conductor.2@web-summit's session, no longer exists (found 1 November 2026 ~18:45 UTC; last wake 14:28 UTC). conductor.3@web-summit now holds the seat; the schedule restarts into its session only at the operator's word.
runs.job: open the wake, plan which roles run, run them as sub-agents, review, release, log, close
